title: Set 2  Let's Clean the Classroom!
subtitle: 对应课本：Unit 1 My classroom

dialogue.t: OK! I can clean the board.
Good! Zhang Peng, can you clean the floor?
Thank you, boys and girls. Wow! The classroom is clean now.
Look at the picture on the wall. It's nice!

vocab: clean 打扫/干净的 · board 黑板 · window 窗户 · floor 地板 · picture 图画 · wall 墙 · classroom 教室

sections.title: A. 判断对错（T 对，F 错）

questions.stem: Miss White says, "Let's clean the classroom!"
questions.why: 第一句就是 Class, let's clean the classroom!
Mike 擦黑板（board），Amy 擦窗户。

questions.stem: Zhang Peng can clean the floor.

questions.why: Amy: I can clean the window.
Look at the picture on the wall.

questions.stem: Is the classroom clean now? (Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.)
questions.why: Miss White: The classroom is clean now.
